subject: Proposal: Expand Hosted Commit + Tier Rescaling (Q4 onboarding)
messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.ai>
To: Amit Desai <amit@iriscommerce.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 27 Jul 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: Expand Hosted Commit + Tier Rescaling (Q4 onboarding)

Hi Amit —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our conversation, attached is a compact proposal to:
- increase your monthly hosted commit from 1.2B tokens to 2.0B (phased over two months)
- reclassify to the higher throughput tier (reduced per-token rate but a 12-month annual term)
- add a soft latency safeguard for peak windows (SLA exception process included)

Key ask: please review the SOW and the pricing sheet. Procurement (Priya) will need the final SOW + PO by Aug 12 to meet your Q4 ramp.

I attached a redlined SOW and a simple spreadsheet that shows estimated monthly spend at current vs proposed rates. If this looks good, Karthik will prepare the formal commitment amendment and we’ll loop in Finance for invoicing cadence.

Attachments: Iris_Commit_SOW.pdf (SOW draft), iris-pricing-proposal-2027.xlsx (tier math)

Next steps I propose:
- You confirm alignment on committed token count and term length
- We land on billing cadence (monthly vs. quarterly) and burst policy
- Redwood legal issues the amendment for signature

Would you prefer a quick call tomorrow to walk the numbers? I can do 11–11:30 PT.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Account Executive, Enterprise
Redwood Inference

From: Amit Desai <amit@iriscommerce.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Kapoor <procurement@iriscommerce.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Jul 2027 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: Expand Hosted Commit + Tier Rescaling (Q4 onboarding)

Aisha —

Thanks for sending. Quick questions upfront:
1) The proposed per-token rate looks favorable, but can you confirm how burst overage will be billed during seasonal spikes? We want predictability for Black Friday prep.
2) The latency safeguard — is that an add-on with credits or an operational runbook? Our SREs need clarity.

Priya is on copy for procurement timing. We’re targeting a Sept onboarding so Aug 12 PO would be tight but doable. A quick call at 11 PT works for us.

Best,
Amit
VP Engineering — IrisCommerce

On Tue, Jul 27, 2027 at 10:12 AM Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.ai> wrote:
> (original proposal message and attachments)

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.ai>
To: Amit Desai <amit@iriscommerce.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Priya Kapoor <procurement@iriscommerce.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: Expand Hosted Commit + Tier Rescaling (Q4 onboarding)

Thanks, Amit —

Answers below, high level:

1) Burst overage: we propose a controlled burst pocket that is pooled monthly. Any usage above the pooled burst is billed at a capped overage rate (see tab "Burst & Overage" in the spreadsheet). For Black Friday work, we can provision a temporary top-up that converts to committed tokens if you need a longer-term uplift. We’ll include a 30-day notice window for billing changes.

2) Latency safeguard: this is an operational SLA exception path. It includes: automated routing to a local hot-standby model variant, a prioritized support channel during declared peak windows, and a monthly credit pool if we miss the agreed P50/P90 latency targets. The SOW has a detailed runbook excerpt.

Call: 11:00 PT tomorrow confirmed. I’ll invite a brief SRE touchpoint (Laura) to walk the runbook. Karthik — can you confirm whether Finance is okay with monthly invoicing vs. quarterly for this deal?

Cheers,
Aisha

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: Expand Hosted Commit + Tier Rescaling (Q4 onboarding)

Looping in Marissa for legal and billing. Finance is generally fine with monthly invoicing for committed customers; we prefer quarterly in certain regions but can make an exception given IrisCommerce's scale. Billing notes for the amendment:
- If customer opts into the 12-month reduced rate, we need a signed amendment with minimum monthly commitment schedule and PO attached.
- Burst pocket should be explicitly called out as a pooled allowance with a capped overage rate; include sample invoice line items in the amendment so Procurement can map to their PO structure.

Marissa — can you draft a short addendum that includes the billing examples and the latency-credit language? Target: send draft by EOD so Aisha can share with Amit after the call.

Thanks,
Karthik
VP, Customer Success Ops

From: Amit Desai <amit@iriscommerce.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Priya Kapoor <procurement@iriscommerce.com>
Date: Fri, 29 Jul 2027 15:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: Expand Hosted Commit + Tier Rescaling (Q4 onboarding)

Aisha / team —

Call was helpful. Priya has reviewed the SOW and pricing; procurement wants the amendment with the following clarified before PO:
- Confirm the effective start date if we sign the amendment mid-September (we expect token usage to ramp 9/15–10/15).
- Add line items for the burst top-up option and a one-time Black Friday temporary capacity addendum.
- Include a 30-day cancellation notice for any additional top-ups (not the base commit).

If you can add those items and share a redlined amendment by Mon EOD, we’ll process the PO and target a Sept 15 start for the phased commit increase.

Thanks — Amit

---
Amit Desai
VP Engineering | IrisCommerce
